key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.2s): Initial archival pose of megaphone; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.33s): Mid-sequence articulation of megaphone; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.56s): Peak dynamic extension of megaphone over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=4.8s): Follow-through and settle of megaphone with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of megaphone (1.2s..4.8s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
